title: Stipple gouache

reference.source: Reference 2: gouache on canvas, 1000 × 1254 px JPEG
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Flat paint whose edges are dissolved by dabbed dots, all of it sitting on one canvas weave that shades the paint and shows through as specks.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 1000 × 1254 and every length scales with the canvas

fringe.does: How far the dabs climb into the shape.

groundDots.does: Scattered dabs across the ground band.

pitch.does: Thread spacing. Fine linen to coarse burlap.

weave.does: How strongly the threads shade the paint.

skips.does: Paint skipping the weave peaks. More on dark paint.

streaks.does: Pale vertical strokes that only catch the thread tops.

branch.does: Swing of the outlined stroke that ties the shapes together. 0 removes it.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Weave
techniques.implementation: Open sky: the 4 px lattice at ±16 levels, 45 % lattice and 55 % tooth, column means 99 to 116.

techniques.name: Speck
techniques.implementation: Knot: the top thread's crest at a crossing, its brightness drawn from an exponential tail; the strongest break through to primer.

techniques.name: Dab
techniques.implementation: Stipple fringe: dabs in the sky color climb into the pale shape, exponential in depth, 4.4 to 7.4 px radius.

techniques.name: Paint
techniques.implementation: Disc: flat paint; its edge is the one hard edge on the sheet.

techniques.name: Streak
techniques.implementation: Dry-brush streak: pale paint that only reaches thread tops, gated by lattice height above 0.42.

pass_order: flat paint: sky wash with a 26-level warm drift toward the foot, disc, ground, lobed shapes
dry-brush streaks into a mask (they only catch thread tops)
dabs: three-tone discs lit from the upper left, in the neighboring color, dense at the edge and thinning inward; ground dabs in the sky color with a pale center

thread lattice: straight warp threads on a 4 px pitch, weft threads on 4.4 px that wander by up to 6 px, each thread set off its grid line by up to ±0.075 pitch and carrying its own brightness (±7 %); the top thread at each crossing sets the height, and its knots carry an exponential brightness tail (scale 0.04) so a few stand 2 to 3 times brighter; 45 % lattice, 55 % 1.6 px tooth
paint load: two scales of luminance drift, 160 px and 22 px
weave shading: valleys floored at 0.2 so the dark side is shallow; shapes are laid on 0.45 as thick as the sky wash
primer specks on the knots of the weave: strength per knot (cubed), more on dark paint and where the load is thin

weave_pitch_px.method: column-profile autocorrelation ±0.8 at lag 4 in the sky patch; row-profile peaks at lags 4 to 5 and 13 to 14

column_profile.method: local maxima of the column means, 60..188 × 60..188

ground.method: pixels with B > 0.8 G in 960..1240 × 10..140, components over 20 px

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Lagoon palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The picture is generated, so the pale-paint and ground render rects were placed with search.py on the same material as the reference patches: flat pale paint with a few sky dabs in it, and ground paint with its scattered dabs.

limits: The picture is an original arrangement in the technique; the reference's figure is not redrawn, and the pale-paint and ground rects were chosen with search.py.
The sky histogram scores about 0.88: the reference's lobe is 47 % in one 16-level bin with a tail to 224; the lattice shading plus the knot tail gives 37 % in that bin.
The ground histogram scores about 0.94: the reference's ground lobe is 58 % in one bin with its spread in the dabs; one weave depth serves every paint here, scaled 0.45 on the shapes.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
